room_rent.note: Policy wording does not mention any room rent cap or category restriction; room rent is listed as a covered expense but no limit is stated

icu.note: ICU charges are listed as a covered expense but no specific cap or limit is mentioned in the wording

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording; aggregate deductible applies instead

sub_limits.display: Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI; maternity capped at ₹1L; ambulance ₹3,500/hosp
sub_limits.note: Modern treatments sub-limited to 50% of SI; maternity benefit capped at ₹1 lakh; ambulance capped at ₹3,500 per hospitalisation; no other disease-wise sub-limits found

deductible.display: Aggregate deductible applies (amount per Certificate of Insurance)
deductible.note: An annual aggregate deductible is mandatory; the exact rupee amount is specified in the Certificate of Insurance and not in the policy wording itself

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt; waived if continuously covered for more than 12 months

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases covered after 24 months of continuous coverage; portability credit applicable

specific_disease_waiting.note: Listed conditions (ENT, gynaecological, orthopaedic, GI, eye, etc.) have 24-month waiting period; accidents exempt

maternity.display: Covered (12mo wait, up to ₹1L, max 2 deliveries)
maternity.note: Inbuilt benefit; available after 12 months from first policy inception; limited to ₹1 lakh; maximum 2 deliveries or terminations lifetime

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative bonus or no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration or reinstatement of sum insured benefit mentioned in the policy wording

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days before admission for the same condition

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same condition

day_care.note: Day care coverage limited to the list of procedures specified in Annexure-I of the policy

domiciliary.note: Covered if condition lasts at least 3 days; excludes asthma, bronchitis, epilepsy, influenza, gastroenteritis, arthritis, gout, tonsillitis, and several other conditions

ayush.note: AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in excess of aggregate deductible; must be in registered AYUSH hospital or day care centre; no pre/post hospitalisation covered

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation expenses of organ donor covered; pre/post hospitalisation of donor not covered; organ must be for the insured person

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹3,500 per hospitalisation; life-threatening emergency must be certified by medical practitioner

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy, etc.) covered up to 50% of sum insured in excess of aggregate deductible

consumables.note: Non-medical/consumable expenses listed in Annexure-II are explicitly excluded; no rider available mentioned

global_cover.note: Policy explicitly covers treatment within India only; overseas treatment is a listed exclusion

moratorium.note: After 8 continuous years, policy cannot be voided for non-disclosure except for proven fraud and permanent exclusions

grace_period.note: Grace period of 30 days after premium due date; coverage not available during grace period but continuity benefits preserved

free_look.note: Free look period of at least 15 days from date of receipt of policy; applicable only to new policies, not renewals

portability.note: Portability as per IRDAI norms; prior coverage credit applicable for PED and time-bound exclusions

notable_exclusions.display: Permanent exclusions: cancer, epilepsy, heart disease, stroke, CKD, Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, Hep B, IBD, avascular necrosis if pre-existing at proposal

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-on covers mentioned in the policy wording
